code: library(ducksemantics)  # `con` is the already initialized RClinVarbitration DuckDB connection. ducksemantics_init(con)  documents <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "   SELECT semantic_document_id, text   FROM clinvar_semantic_documents   WHERE release_id = 'ncbi-vcv-2026-07-02'     AND section IN ('comment', 'attribute:Description')     AND length(text) >= 40 ")  vectors <- ducksemantics_embed_cached(   documents$text,   provider = dense_provider,   cache_dir = "clinvar-embedding-cache" ) ducksemantics_embedding_batch(   vectors,   subject_id = documents$semantic_document_id,   subject_kind = "clinvar_document",   provider = "embeddinggemma-clinvar-v1",   text = documents$text ) |>   ducksemantics_write_embeddings(con, replace = TRUE) SELECT h.vcv_accession, h.scv_entity_id, h.hpo_id, n.label FROM clinvar_hpo_terms h JOIN semantic_nodes n   ON n.family = 'HPO' AND n.node_id = h.hpo_id WHERE h.release_id = 'ncbi-vcv-2026-07-02'; SELECT cg.symbol AS gene_symbol,        max(h.score) AS best_text_score,        count(DISTINCT d.semantic_document_id) AS supporting_documents,        max(g.pathogenic_allele_count) AS clinvar_pathogenic_alleles FROM semantic_hits h JOIN clinvar_semantic_documents d   ON d.semantic_document_id = h.subject_id JOIN clinvar_genes cg   ON cg.release_id = d.release_id AND cg.vcv_accession = d.vcv_accession LEFT JOIN clinvar_gene_summary_cache g   ON g.release_id = d.release_id AND g.symbol = cg.symbol GROUP BY cg.symbol ORDER BY best_text_score DESC, supporting_documents DESC;

Repeated source elements remain rows rather nested values. XML-derived policy decisions remain SQL views materialized explicit export. former public relation names remain query-compatible views. Add rclinvarbitration_import_flat() compact default import. joins official variant_summary submission_summary reports directly canonical table. XML importer now feeds table richer source evidence needed. Release-scale flat imports execute one bounded record-kind projection time large deduplication policy states remain live together. Retain GRCh37 GRCh38 locations side side. clinvar_vcf exposes VCF CHROM/POS/REF/ALT tuples, preserves exact sequence accessions, keeps alternate placements distinct, collapse X/Y PAR placements. Source locations lacking complete VCF tuple remain clinvar. Allele-level decisions allele-gene facts deduplicate semantic keys even one allele multiple placements source gene list repeats token. Include alternate-accession decisions seven-column compatibility export using official ClinVar VCF CHROM. complete March 2026 audit found 40 rows pinned upstream ClinVarbitration relabels alternate-locus position chr17, chr19, chr22, chr9; NCBI’s archived GRCh38 VCF clinvar_vcf agree exactly accession, POS/REF/ALT, VariationID, AlleleID. Add rclinvarbitration_publish_ducklake() single key-based publication path tidy ClinVar exports. registers Parquet without collecting rows R, leaves unchanged records untouched, publishes inserts, updates, withdrawals one snapshot, returns native DuckLake change counts. Use temporary spill-backed XML staging project record kind one contiguous block. Staging longer leaves high-water mark free blocks durable database. legacy-layout guard prevents old base tables overwritten compatibility views. Give every canonical row stable record_key. Tidy Parquet retains repeated release label release_id, returns release receipt separately, contains nested columns, compared exactly DuckLake. Add clinvar_gene_disease_summaries descriptive, policy-versioned ClinVar evidence strata. support retrieval temporal reanalysis represented gene-validity classifications. Add case-insensitive submitter exclusions named policy profiles without deleting imported source submissions. Add clinvar_hpo_terms, clinvar_literature_links, clinvar_semantic_documents, disease-aware clinvar_gene_summaries source-attributed retrieval VariantStory integration. Add rclinvarbitration_download_clinvar() current archived VCV XML, submission_summary, variant_summary releases. Add native x86-64 Windows extension builds using Rtools-provided libxml2, zlib, target-aware pkg-config; retain Linux, macOS, webR builds. Runtime artifact selection now matches exact DuckDB platform metadata includes windows_amd64 R-devel’s windows_amd64_mingw identities. Execute pinned upstream TSV algorithm exact March 2026 flat inputs: 4,125,389 keys values match package reproducer. Classify 377 XML/flat key value differences source-row receipts, quantify sample/method/observed-data/consequence XML structure coverage. Add release-differential tests disease keys, SCV replacement, withdrawn assertions, compound alleles, mitochondrial locations, plus curated real HPO PubMed context projections. Add experimental webR/WebAssembly support. package now builds version-matched DuckDB extension Emscripten side module browser smoke test loads imports compressed VCV fixture. Project compact parser rows package-owned rclinvar_json_field() scalar rather DuckDB’s separately downloadable JSON extension. Imports require extension download, including browser/webR runtimes. Remove premature local v1 policy suffix; preserve pinned cpg-clinvarbitration-2.2.11 identifier, source-order strong-review rule, separate disease- allele-level decision views. Retain imported SCV source order deterministic strong-review decisions. Bundle exact C_STRUCT_UNSTABLE extension artifacts DuckDB v1.5.0 v1.5.5, selected enabled connection’s engine version.
